## Tried
- `2026-11-11` DECISION: Privacy scrub (meterbill/ingest/scrub.py). Event properties lose keys email, ip, phone, user_agent and any key starting 'pii_' at ingest (before store) and via 'events scrub --tenant T --period P' on stored month files (atomic rewrite like compaction; untouched lines stay byte-identical; .idem index unchanged). Matching is exact, case-sensitive, top-level keys only: 'Email' and nested keys are NOT dropped. Ingest summary counts drops per tenant (TenantCounts.scrubbed) for accepted events only, since duplicates are not stored. Rejects log still holds raw rows as submitted, so retention is what covers PII there.
- `2026-11-11` DECISION: Retention plan changed by the privacy review, SUPERSEDES #47's note: files in data/rejects are kept 30 days (not 90) because they hold raw rows we never accepted. Raw events stay 25 months after the END of their billing period. HARD RULE for any purge, whatever the age: never delete events of a period that has no finalized invoice yet, or that has a credit note issued in the last 12 months. Purge itself is still NOT built.
